title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Install UK localization as an extension to the base app (UK Delocalization)
summary: UK localization for Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) is now available as extensions on the W1 base app instead of being built into the core product. This delocalization approach reduces implementation costs, simplifies multi-region operations, and allows ISVs broader market access.
key_points: UK localization features are delivered as a set of extensions on the W1 base app starting in BC27
Delocalization reduces implementation time and costs, particularly for organizations operating in multiple regions
Includes a data upgrade feature to simplify transition from the previous localized version
Users can choose to adopt new features during a three-release period before old features are deprecated
Extensions cover VAT and tax, banking and payments, fixed assets, and general UK-specific functionality

quotes.text: Removing country-based customizations from the base app helps organizations save time and reduce costs during implementation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core business value of delocalization for cost and time efficiency

quotes.text: After this period, the previous features will be deprecated, and the new localization will automatically be enabled.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the transition timeline and mandatory adoption plan for the new extension-based model
